title: Do you work here?
goal_hi: Naye logon se work ke baare me sawaal poochna aur apna intro dena.

pattern.frame: Do you work ___? / What do you do?

forms.positive: I work in-house as a frontend developer.
forms.negative: I don't work for an agency.
forms.question: Do you work here?

pattern.note_hi: Sawaal me 'Do you' se shuru karo; 'What do you do?' ka matlab kaam kya karte ho.

examples.en: What do you do at this company?
examples.hi: Aap is company me kya karte ho?

examples.en: I'm a freelancer, so I work with different clients.
examples.hi: Main freelancer hoon, isliye alag clients ke saath kaam karta hoon.

examples.en: She's the founder of a small agency.
examples.hi: Woh ek chhoti agency ki founder hai.

examples.en: I work in-house, not for an agency.
examples.hi: Main in-house kaam karta hoon, agency ke liye nahi.

words.example_en: She's the founder of the company.

words.hi: clients ke liye kaam karne wali company
words.example_en: I work at a design agency.
words.example_hi: Main ek design agency me kaam karta hoon.

words.example_en: I work in-house with the product team.
words.example_hi: Main product team ke saath in-house kaam karta hoon.

dialogue.title: Meeting someone new
dialogue.context_hi: Work event me naye insaan se milna.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi, I'm Priya. Do you work here?
lines.hi: Hi, main Priya. Aap yahan kaam karte ho?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Hi Priya, I'm Azim. Yes, I work in-house as a frontend developer.
lines.hi: Hi Priya, main Azim. Haan, main in-house frontend developer hoon.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hi: Badhiya. Aapka role exactly kya hai?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I build responsive websites and handle client meetings.
lines.hi: Main responsive websites banata hoon aur client meetings handle karta hoon.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Are you a freelancer or part of an agency?
lines.hi: Aap freelancer ho ya agency ka part?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm in-house, but I also freelance on weekends.
lines.hi: Main in-house hoon, lekin weekends par freelance bhi karta hoon.

sound_focus.tip_hi: Sawaal ke end me awaaz upar karo: 'Do you WORK here?'

scenario.title_hi: Work event me naye insaan se milna
scenario.setting_hi: Ek small work event me stranger se baat.
